mapper.select: select count(1) from register_distribution rd left join register_distribution rdd on rd.distribution_person_id=rdd.user_id left join t_user tu on tu.id = rd.user_id where rd.type=2 and tu.id_auth = '3' and tu.photo_auth = '3' and tu.edu_auth = '3' and rdd.distribution_person_id=#{userId}

select rd.id from register_distribution rd left join register_distribution rdd on rd.distribution_person_id = rdd.user_id left join t_user tu on tu.id = rd.user_id where rd.type = 2 and tu.id_auth = '3' and tu.photo_auth = '3' and tu.edu_auth = '3' and rd.higher_reward_status = '0' and rdd.distribution_person_id = #{userId}
